'''Kenji Hamada''' (Japanese: '''浜田賢二''' ''Hamada Kenji'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hamada was born on April 12, 1972, in {{wp|Fukuoka}}, {{wp|Fukuoka Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. As an adult, he became a voice actor and was affiliated with talent management agency {{wp|Mausu Promotion}}. Hamada lent his voice for two characters in {{aniseries|PTS}}: [[Ferris]], a recurring character in {{aniseries|BW}}; and [[Sherman]], a [[character of the day]] who appeared in {{aniseries|BW}}.
